title: The single biggest reason why start-ups succeed | Bill Gross | TED
summary: Bill Gross, who has founded and incubated many start-ups, ranked hundreds of companies on five factors. He presents the one factor that stood out as the biggest predictor of success.
why: HN commenters cite it for its finding that timing is the most important factor in startup success.

quote.text: timing is the most important factor in a startups success.
